issueTitle: Todo Management - Create, Complete, Filter and Delete
blocker: GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured. Copy .env.example to .env and add a Gemini Developer API key.

scenarios.title: Unverified: AC-01
scenarios.expected: A new task with valid text appears in the list.
scenarios.reason: GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured. Copy .env.example to .env and add a Gemini Developer API key.

scenarios.expected: A user can mark a created task complete and see its completed state.

scenarios.expected: The Active filter hides completed tasks and shows active tasks.
scenarios.reason: GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured. Copy .env.example to .env and add a Gemini Developer API key.
